content.text:
[build-system]
requires = [
    "setuptools",
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demospipes_api"
version = "1.0.5"
description = "API for DEMOSpipes."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "demos",
    "demospipes",
    "api",
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
]
dependencies = [
    "fastapi[standard]~=0.136.3",
    "pydantic-settings~=2.14.2",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.14.0",
    "pylint>=3.3.0",
    "bandit[toml]>=1.8.0",
    "mypy>=1.18.0",
]
test = [
    "asgi-lifespan>=2.1.0",
    "pytest>=9.1.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
    "pytest-mock>=3.15.1",
]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = [
    "src",
]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
demospipes_api = [
    "*.ini",
    "py.typed",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
exclude = [
    ".venv",
    "__pycache__",
    ".git",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
=== core ===
[build-system]
requires = [
    "setuptools",
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demospipes_core"
version = "1.0.5"
description = "Core functionality for DEMOSpipes executors."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "demos",
    "demospipes",
    "executor",
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
]
dependencies = [
    "aiohttp~=3.14.3",
    "demospipes-data-structures",
    "prefect==3.7.4",
    "prefect-docker==0.7.2",
    "prefect-kubernetes==0.7.10",
    "pydantic~=2.13.4",
    "pydantic-settings~=2.14.2",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.14.0",
    "pylint>=3.3.0",
    "bandit[toml]>=1.8.0",
    "mypy>=1.18.0",
    "pre-commit>=4.2.0",
]
test = [
    "pytest>=9.1.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
]

[tool.uv.sources.demospipes-data-structures]
path = "../data-structures"

[tool.uv.audit]
ignore = []

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = [
    "src",
]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
demospipes_core = [
    "py.typed",
]

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat 02-backend/demospipes/api/pyproject.toml | head -60; echo "=== core ==="; cat 02-backend/demospipes/core/pyproject.toml | head -60
